title: Work IQ: granular MCP policies to restrict platforms, workloads and operations
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap targets, current tenant policy path and consumption licensing are supported. The changed Work IQ overview still supports the licensing statements, and the briefing distinguishes the planned granular controls from today's policy and reports the differing documented write defaults.
